rewrites.comment: SPA fallback for real routes only. The previous catch-all rewrote EVERY miss to index.html, so a font or photo that wasn't there came back as 200 text/html instead of 404 — the browser downloaded HTML, failed to parse it as a font, and only then fell back to the next family. Paths carrying a file extension are excluded so they 404 cleanly; edition routes like /2026/october have no dot and still resolve.
